pr_body:
(see individual commits)

- Add the `enriched_properties` option which will control which properties are included in the enriched envelope.
- The enriched envelope in json should not include the `payload` wrapper unless the schema is included.

Epic: CRDB-8665
Fixes: #139687
Release note: None

issue_context.title: Metadata/Enriched envelope: implement "enriched_properties" option
issue_context.body:
Only supported in new envelope
Takes csv of sections to include, e.g. `enriched_properties='schema, source'`
supported sections: schema, source

Also, in json: if the schema is not included, remove the `"payload"` wrapper object.

Epic CRDB-8665

Jira issue: CRDB-46770

review_comments: Do we also want to add tests for the error messages if you specify an illegal property?
